headers.title: Client Testimonials
headers.subTitle: What others say about working with me

items.text: A compelling testimonial focuses on specific results or experiences rather than generic praise. The quote should sound authentic and conversational.
Include testimonials from different client types to demonstrate versatility. Each quote should highlight different aspects of your service or approach.
The most powerful testimonials address initial client concerns and how you overcame them. This builds trust with potential clients who may have similar hesitations.
